items.question: What is the toll-free number of the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation's Labour Claims and Advisory Call Centre in the UAE?
items.fact: MoHRE labour call centre toll-free number is 80084

items.question: Under UAE labour dispute rules, below what claim amount in AED are workers exempt from paying litigation fees?
items.fact: Workers exempt from litigation fees for claims under AED 100,000
